title: Point settings
shortNameTooLong: Short name doesn't fit: the device stores {bytes} bytes (≈ {cyr} Cyrillic or {bytes} Latin characters).
nameTooLong: Name doesn't fit: the device stores {bytes} bytes (≈ {cyr} Cyrillic characters).
ratedInvalid: Rating must be a non-negative number.
maxAInvalid: Breaker current must be a non-negative number.
fullListTooBig: the firmware only accepts the whole point list, and it is too large ({size} KB > {max} KB) — update the firmware
savedRoleChanged: Saved. The role applies immediately; history depth for the new role takes effect after the device reboots.
roleLockedConflict: The hub keeps the input's role fixed — it can't be changed.
name: Name
shortNameHelper: {used}/{max} bytes · empty — taken from the name
roleLockedHelper: the input's role is fixed by the hub
roleHelper: determines whether the point counts as generation, a charging station, etc.
inputLimitHelper: permitted input power — the basis for “headroom”
breakerHelper: breaker rated current; empty — not set
groupHelper: A tab on the energy-flow schema. Group names are in Settings.
groupHelperEmpty: No groups yet — create them in Settings → “Consumer groups”.
trunkHelper: Measures the whole group; the other points are its breakdown and do not add on top.
nameDuplicate: Another point already has this name — they will be hard to tell apart
ratedTooBig: Over 1000 kW — check the units (the field is in kW)
ratedAboveBreaker: More than the breaker allows (≈ {kw} kW) — please check
ratedBelowBreaker: Well below the breaker (≈ {kw} kW) — intended?
evMin: This station's idle after a session, min
evHubHelper: Empty or 0 — the hub's: {value} (“Settings → Charging stations”).
evWInvalid: Station threshold: whole watts from 0 to 100,000.
evMinInvalid: Idle time: whole minutes from 0 to 1440.
ctHelper: Choose the sensor actually on the channel (the factory wrote the one it calibrated with — usually SCT-013-030). Its nominal current should cover the line's maximum; a much bigger sensor has a higher noise floor. Applies at once, written into the module.
ctFixed: The module's own sensor (CT- series), calibrated with the channel at the factory — the model is fixed.
ctFixedConflict: CT- series module: the sensor is factory-paired and calibrated, its model can't change.
ctRejected: The hub didn't take the sensor model: {message}
ctUncalibratedHelper: The sensor model can't be chosen: the module wasn't calibrated.
ctOverLimit: The line breaker {a} A is above the sensor's limit ({hi} A): current above it is clipped and metering silently under-counts. Fit a sensor with a higher rating.
ctOverLimitInput: The input breaker {a} A is above the sensor's limit ({hi} A): current above it is clipped and metering silently under-counts. Fit a sensor with a higher rating.
ctWriteWarn: The model is written to the module together with its type calibration. If the channel was factory-calibrated with your sensor, that calibration is lost and cannot be restored. Change the model only if a different sensor is really fitted on the channel.
